en.title: Maximum XOR Not Exceeding a Limit Within a Range
en.description:
Choose lo≤a<b≤hi such that a XOR b≤k and the XOR value is as large as possible; return the XOR value. The two integers must be different; if no feasible pair exists, this site outputs -1.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing lo hi k. Full source ranges: 1≤lo<hi≤10000, 1≤k≤10000.
hints: Run a two-number digit DP from the high bit to the low bit, tracking whether each number is still tight against its lower and upper bounds, whether a is already less than b, and whether the XOR is still tight against k, and enumerate the current pair of bits.
